nodes.title: COMMENT
code:
POLARITY - a sisterly life sim.
BOOT: BASIC off, CIA IRQs off,
mirror tables, then the title.

nodes.title: CODE BLOCK
code:
; ---------------------------------------------------------------
; BOOT - runs once after SYSTEM INIT.
; Bank BASIC out ($01=$36): the charsets/tables above $A000 are RAM.
; Quiet the CIA timer interrupts: only our raster interrupts run.
; Build the two mirror tables the sprite code uses to flip the sisters.
; ---------------------------------------------------------------
LDA #$36
STA $01
LDA #$7F
STA $DC0D
STA $DD0D
LDA $DC0D
LDA $DD0D
LDA #$01
STA $C01E
LDA #$00
STA $C027
STA $D015
LDA #$A7
STA $C01C
LDA #$03
STA $C000
LDA #$FF               ; no charset copied into VIC memory yet
STA $C034
LDX #$00
BTFlip:
TXA                    ; hires: reverse the 8 bits
STA $C01F
LDY #8
BTHr:
LSR $C01F
ROL
DEY
BNE BTHr
STA $C200,X
TXA                    ; multicolour: reverse the 4 bit pairs
STA $C01F
LDA #$00
STA $C020
LDY #4
BTMc:
ASL $C020
ASL $C020
LDA $C01F
AND #$03
ORA $C020
STA $C020
LSR $C01F
LSR $C01F
DEY
BNE BTMc
LDA $C020
STA $C300,X
INX
BNE BTFlip
JMP Title

nodes.title: COMMENT
code:
Title picture + theme tune.
Alternates with HOW TO PLAY.
FIRE starts a new life.

nodes.title: CODE BLOCK
code:
; ---------------------------------------------------------------
; TITLE: the picture, the tune and the SFX player are set up above.
; Start the raster interrupt chain (IrqMusic plays the tune and SFX
; every frame), then hold the title screen.
; ---------------------------------------------------------------
SEI
LDA #<IrqMusic
STA $0314
LDA #>IrqMusic
STA $0315
LDA #$FB
STA $D012
LDA $D011
AND #$7F
STA $D011
LDA #$01
STA $D01A
STA $D019
CLI
JMP TitleHold

nodes.title: CODE BLOCK
code:
; ---------------------------------------------------------------
; TITLE CYCLE: the picture for 5 seconds, then HOW TO PLAY for 12
; seconds, then back to the picture. FIRE on either starts a new life.
; ---------------------------------------------------------------
TitleHold:
LDA #$00
STA $D015
STA $C027
THRelease:
JSR FrameTick
LDA $DC00
AND #$10
BEQ THRelease
LDA #$FA               ; 250 frames = 5 seconds
STA $C01F
LDA #$00
STA $C020
THPic:
JSR FrameTick
JSR TitleFire
JSR TitleCount
BNE THPic
JSR ShowHelp
LDA #$58               ; 600 frames = 12 seconds
STA $C01F
LDA #$02
STA $C020
THHelp:
JSR FrameTick
JSR TitleFire
JSR TitleCount
BNE THHelp
JMP TitlePic

; TitleCount: 16-bit countdown in T0/T1, Z set when it reaches zero.
TitleCount:
LDA $C01F
BNE TCLow
DEC $C020
TCLow:
DEC $C01F
LDA $C01F
ORA $C020
RTS

; TitleFire: FIRE pressed? wait for release, then start the game.
TitleFire:
LDA $DC00
AND #$10
BEQ TFGo
RTS
TFGo:
JSR FrameTick
LDA $DC00
AND #$10
BEQ TFGo
LDX #$FF
TXS
LDA $D012
EOR $C01C
ORA #$01
STA $C01C
JMP StartGame

nodes.title: COMMENT
code:
FrameTick: frame wait.
IrqMusic: raster IRQ chain
(tune, SFX, sky/HUD split).

nodes.title: CODE BLOCK
code:
; ---------------------------------------------------------------
; IrqMusic (raster line 251): ack, play the tune (when on), set up the
; next interrupt of the chain, then the SFX UPDATE node below runs and
; JMP $EA81 returns.  Chain: 251 music -> 58 sky colour -> 218 black.
; The sky / black split gives the HUD rows a black background while the
; scene in between shows the sky colour of the current hour.
; ---------------------------------------------------------------
LDA #$FF
STA $D019
LDA $C01E
BEQ IrqNoTune
JSR sng501000_play
IrqNoTune:
LDA #<IrqSky
STA $0314
LDA #>IrqSky
STA $0315
LDA #58
STA $D012

nodes.title: CODE BLOCK
code:
JMP $EA81              ; KERNAL: pull Y, X, A and RTI

; IrqSky (line 58): the scene rows show the sky colour.
IrqSky:
LDA #$FF
STA $D019
LDA $C027
BEQ ISkyNext
LDA $C026
STA $D021
ISkyNext:
LDA #<IrqHud
STA $0314
LDA #>IrqHud
STA $0315
LDA #218
STA $D012
JMP $EA81

; IrqHud (line 218): black behind the bottom HUD and the top status row.
IrqHud:
LDA #$FF
STA $D019
LDA $C027
BEQ IHudNext
LDA #$00
STA $D021
IHudNext:
LDA #<IrqMusic
STA $0314
LDA #>IrqMusic
STA $0315
LDA #$FB
STA $D012
JMP $EA81

; ---------------------------------------------------------------
; NEW LIFE: the VIC, sprite, clear and HUD nodes above set the screen up.
; Reset the sisters' needs, money, clock, job and clues, then walk into
; HOME. Sprites: 0/1 her hires overlays, 2 her body (multicolour, double
; height), 3 magic, 4 coin or clue, 5 bee, 5-7 the person in the room.
; ---------------------------------------------------------------
LDA #$00
STA $C002
STA $C003
STA $C00C
STA $C00D
STA $C014
STA $C015
STA $C018
STA $C023
STA $C024
STA $C029
STA $C028
STA $C007
STA $C006
STA $C005
STA $C02F
STA $C033
STA $C03A
STA $C046
STA $C047
STA $C042
STA $C048
STA $C049
STA $C04A
STA $C04B
LDA #20
STA $C008
LDA #$01
STA $C00A
STA $C013
STA $C009
LDA #$03            ; a new life starts at HOME
STA $C000
LDA #8
STA $C00B
LDA #36
LDX #4
NGNeeds:
STA $C00E,X
DEX
BPL NGNeeds
LDA #60
STA $C001
LDA #$84               ; bodies multicolour and double height
STA $D01C
STA $D017
LDA #$00
STA $D01D
STA $D01B
LDA #$07               ; only the girl is on
STA $D015
JSR SetGirlCols
LDA #$01
STA $C027
JSR SetSky
JSR RefreshHud
LDA #$7F
JSR PrintMsg
LDA #$FF               ; no prompt yet: the welcome line stays up
STA $C01D
JMP EnterRoomKeep

nodes.title: COMMENT
code:
11 places: 5 CHAR_SETs, MAPs
under the I/O + KERNAL, the
person and clue in each.

nodes.title: CODE BLOCK
code:
// @asset CHARS_HOUSE
// @asset CHARS_COTTAGE
// @asset CHARS_TOWN
// @asset CHARS_SHOPS
// @asset CHARS_GREEN
// @asset MAP_GRANS
// @asset MAP_GARDEN
// @asset MAP_BEDROOM
// @asset MAP_HOME
// @asset MAP_STREET
// @asset MAP_CAFE
// @asset MAP_SHOP
// @asset MAP_SWINGS
// @asset MAP_PARK
// @asset MAP_WOODS
// @asset MAP_LIBRARY
// @asset SPR_LIB

; (these lines tell the build to include every place's charset and map
;  and the sprite library: this code copies them in itself)
; ---------------------------------------------------------------
; ENTER ROOM: blank the screen, copy this place's charset + colours,
; draw its 40x20 map into rows 1-20, name it, bring in its person,
; its clue, a coin / bee.
; Reset the stack: room changes jump here from inside joystick handlers.
; ---------------------------------------------------------------
EnterRoom:
LDX #$FF
TXS
LDA #$FE
STA $C01D              ; next frame shows this spot's prompt / hint
EnterRoomKeep:
LDA $D011
AND #$EF
STA $D011
JSR CopyRoomGfx
JSR DrawRoom
JSR PlaceName
JSR SetupNpc
JSR SetupClue
JSR SpawnThings
JSR SetSky
JSR FrameTick
LDA $D011
ORA #$10
STA $D011
JMP MainLoop

; CopyRoomGfx: this room's CHAR_SET -> $3000 (2K), its colour table -> $C100,
; its shared colour -> $D022. Rooms of a group share one charset.
CopyRoomGfx:
LDX $C000
LDA $AD44,X
CMP $C034
BNE CRGNew
RTS
CRGNew:
STA $C034
TAX
LDA $AD54,X
STA $D022
LDA $AD4F,X
STA $55
LDA #$00
STA $54
STA $50
LDA #$30
STA $51
LDX #$08
LDY #$00
CRGLoop:
LDA ($54),Y
STA ($50),Y
INY
BNE CRGLoop
INC $55
INC $51
DEX
BNE CRGLoop
LDA $C034
CLC
ADC #$A8
STA $55
LDY #$00
CRGCol:
LDA ($54),Y
STA $C100,Y
INY
BNE CRGCol
RTS

; DrawRoom: the map (40x20 chars = 800 bytes) lives under the I/O area /
; KERNAL, so copy it to screen rows 1-20 with all RAM banked in
; (interrupts off), then colour every cell from the charset's colours.
DrawRoom:
LDX $C000
LDA $AD2E,X
STA $54
LDA $AD39,X
STA $55
LDA #$28
STA $50
STA $52
LDA #$04
STA $51
LDA #$D8
STA $53
SEI
LDA #$34
STA $01
LDX #$03               ; 3 pages + 32 bytes
LDY #$00
DRCopy:
LDA ($54),Y
STA ($50),Y
INY
BNE DRCopy
INC $55
INC $51
DEX
BNE DRCopy
DRTail:
LDA ($54),Y
STA ($50),Y
INY
CPY #32
BNE DRTail
LDA #$36
STA $01
CLI
LDA #$04
STA $51
LDA #$03
STA $C01F
LDY #$00
DRCol:
LDA ($50),Y
TAX
LDA $C100,X
STA ($52),Y
INY
BNE DRCol
INC $51
INC $53
DEC $C01F
BNE DRCol
DRColTail:
LDA ($50),Y
TAX
LDA $C100,X
STA ($52),Y
INY
CPY #32
BNE DRColTail
RTS

; PlaceName: 7-char place name into the top status row.
PlaceName:
LDA $C000
ASL
ASL
ASL
SEC
SBC $C000
TAX
LDY #$00
PNLoop:
LDA $AD73,X
STA $0410,Y
LDA #$03
STA $D810,Y
INX
INY
CPY #7
BNE PNLoop
RTS

; SpawnThings: maybe a floating coin (street, shop, swings, park) and a
; bee (garden, street, swings, woods, daytime). Coins have a 2 hour
; cooldown after a catch, and stay away while a clue is in the room.
SpawnThings:
LDA #$00
STA $C015
STA $C018
LDX $C000
LDA $AD1E,X
STA $C020
AND #$01
BEQ STBee
LDA $C042
BNE STBee
LDA $C028
BNE STBee
JSR Rand
AND #$01
BEQ STBee
LDA #$01
STA $C015
JSR Rand
AND #$3F
CLC
ADC #40
STA $C016
LDA #$60
STA $C017
STBee:
LDA $C020
AND #$02
BEQ STDone
LDA $C00B
CMP #7
BCC STDone
CMP #20
BCS STDone
JSR Rand
AND #$03
BEQ STDone
LDA #$01
STA $C018
LDA #$96
STA $C01A
LDA #29
STA $C024            ; a moment's grace before it can sting
LDA $C001
CMP #74
BCS STBeeLeft
LDA #140
STA $C019
RTS
STBeeLeft:
LDA #6
STA $C019
STDone:
RTS

; Rand: 8-bit Galois LFSR -> A
Rand:
LDA $C01C
ASL
BCC RandNo
EOR #$1D
RandNo:
STA $C01C
RTS

; SetSky: sky colour for the current hour (the raster split shows it).
SetSky:
LDX $C00B
LDA $AD00,X
STA $C026
RTS

nodes.title: CODE BLOCK
code:
; ---------------------------------------------------------------
; MAIN LOOP (once per frame, after FrameTick): clear the per-frame
; flags, then the JOYSTICK node calls one handler (JoyFire, JoyUp ...).
; ---------------------------------------------------------------
LDA $C005
STA $C006
LDA #$00
STA $C005
STA $C01B
STA $C004
INC $C025

nodes.title: CODE BLOCK
code:
; ---------------------------------------------------------------
; Per-frame update: clock, the girl, magic, coin / clue, bee, the
; person in the room, prompts, faint.
; ---------------------------------------------------------------
JSR ClockTick
JSR DrawGirl
JSR DrawMagic
JSR UpdateCoin
JSR UpdateBee
JSR UpdateNpc
JSR CheckSpot
JSR CheckFaint

nodes.title: CODE BLOCK
code:
; ---------------------------------------------------------------
; JOYSTICK HANDLERS (JSR'd by the JOYSTICK node; each must RTS).
; UP jumps (UP+LEFT/RIGHT jumps across). FIRE uses the thing she
; stands at, or talks to the person there; anywhere else, holding FIRE
; is magic. FIRE+DOWN swaps sisters. JOYID / PREVJOY give edge detection.
; ---------------------------------------------------------------
JoyFire:
LDA #$01
STA $C005
LDA $C02F             ; busy (sitting, sleeping...): no input
BNE JFDone
LDA $C01D
CMP #$FE
BCS JFMagic            ; nothing here: magic
LDA $C03A             ; no using things mid-air
BNE JFDone
LDA $C006
CMP #$01
BEQ JFDone             ; one use per press
JMP DoAction
JFMagic:
LDA $C00F
CMP #2
BCS JFCast
LDA $C006
CMP #$01
BEQ JFDone
LDA #$6B
JMP PrintMsg
JFCast:
LDA #$01
STA $C01B
LDA $C006
CMP #$01
BEQ JFDrain
JSR SndMagic
JFDrain:
INC $C022            ; magic costs 1 REST every 64 frames
LDA $C022
AND #$3F
BNE JFDone
DEC $C00F
JMP RefreshBars
JFDone:
RTS

JoyUpRight:
JSR JoyUp
JMP JoyRight
JoyUpLeft:
JSR JoyUp
JMP JoyLeft

JoyUp:
LDA #$02
STA $C005
LDA $C02F
BNE JUDone
LDA $C03A
BNE JUDone
LDA #$01               ; jump! (DrawGirl runs the arc)
STA $C03A
JMP SndJump
JUDone:
RTS

JoySwap:               ; FIRE + DOWN
LDA #$03
STA $C005
LDA $C02F
BNE JDDone
LDA $C006
CMP #$03
BEQ JDDone
LDA $C003             ; SWAP SISTERS
EOR #$01
STA $C003
LDA #30
STA $C023
JSR SetGirlCols
JSR SndSwap
JSR RefreshNames
LDA $C003
CLC
ADC #$72
JMP PrintMsg
JDDone:
RTS

JoyLeft:
LDA #$04
STA $C005
LDA $C02F
BNE JLWall
LDA #$01
STA $C002
STA $C004
LDA $C001
CMP #$02
BCC JLEdge
DEC $C001
RTS
JLEdge:
LDA $C000
BEQ JLEnd
DEC $C000
LDA #145
STA $C001
JMP EnterRoom
JLEnd:
LDA $C006
CMP #$04
BEQ JLWall
LDA #$80
JMP PrintMsg
JLWall:
RTS

JoyRight:
LDA #$05
STA $C005
LDA $C02F
BNE JRDone
LDA #$00
STA $C002
LDA #$01
STA $C004
LDA $C001
CMP #146
BCS JREdge
INC $C001
RTS
JREdge:
LDA $C000
CMP #$0A
BEQ JREnd
INC $C000
LDA #$02
STA $C001
JMP EnterRoom
JREnd:
LDA $C006
CMP #$05
BEQ JRDone
LDA #$80
JMP PrintMsg
JRDone:
RTS

JoyNone:
RTS

nodes.title: COMMENT
code:
3 sprites a sister: 2x high
MC body + 2 hires overlays,
copied from SPR_LIB, mirrored.

nodes.title: CODE BLOCK
code:
; ---------------------------------------------------------------
; DrawGirl: pick her pose (stand / walk / jump / cast) and height.
; The jump follows $B1FA, one step a frame.
; ---------------------------------------------------------------
DrawGirl:
LDA $C02F
BEQ DGNormal
JMP DrawPose
DGNormal:
LDA $C001
STA $C037
LDA #$9A
STA $C038
LDA $C03A
BEQ DGGround
TAX
LDA #$9A
SEC
SBC $B1FA,X
STA $C038
INC $C03A
LDA $C03A
CMP #$1E
BCC DGAir
LDA #$00
STA $C03A
DGAir:
LDA #$03
LDX $C01B
BEQ DGSet
LDA #$04
JMP DGSet
DGGround:
LDA #$04
LDX $C01B
BNE DGSet
LDA $C004
BEQ DGStand
LDA $C025            ; walk (in profile): stride / legs together, 8 frames each
AND #$08
BNE DGStep
LDA $C038               ; the stride sits 2 lines lower: her head bobs
CLC
ADC #2
STA $C038
LDA #$01
JMP DGSet
DGStep:
LDA #$02
JMP DGSet
DGStand:
LDA #$00
DGSet:
STA $C03C

; ---------------------------------------------------------------
; ShowGirl: show her as pose GP at GX (half pixels), GY (raster).
; A new pose, sister or facing copies its three library blocks into the
; bank 0 buffers (mirrored when she faces left): sprite 0 = top overlay,
; 1 = bottom overlay (21 lines lower), 2 = the double-height body.
; ---------------------------------------------------------------
ShowGirl:
LDA $C003
ASL
ASL
ASL
ASL
ORA $C03C
LDX $C002
BEQ SGKey
ORA #$80
SGKey:
CMP $C03B
BEQ SGPlace
STA $C03B
LDX $C003
LDA $B25A,X
STA $C03D
LDA $C03C               ; row = form*30 + pose*3
ASL
CLC
ADC $C03C
CLC
ADC $C03D
STA $C03E
TAX
LDA $B218,X
LDY #$00
JSR CopyBlock
LDX $C03E
LDA $B219,X
LDY #$01
JSR CopyBlock
LDX $C03E
LDA $B21A,X
LDY #$02
JSR CopyBlock
LDA $C002
BEQ SGPlace
LDY #$00               ; facing left: mirror the three buffers
JSR BufPtr
JSR MirrorHR
LDY #$01
JSR BufPtr
JSR MirrorHR
LDY #$02
JSR BufPtr
JSR MirrorMC
SGPlace:
LDA $C037
JSR SprX
STA $D000
STA $D002
STA $D004
LDA $D010
AND #$F8
LDX $C02C
BEQ SGHi
ORA #$07
SGHi:
STA $D010
LDA $C038
STA $D001
STA $D005
CLC
ADC #21
STA $D003
RTS

; SetGirlCols: this sister's hair ($D026) and dress (body colour);
; the overlays are black, $D025 is skin. Forces a fresh copy.
SetGirlCols:
LDX $C003
LDA $AD1A,X
STA $D026
LDA $AD18,X
STA $D029
LDA #$0A
STA $D025
LDA #$00
STA $D027
STA $D028
LDA #$FF
STA $C03B
RTS

; BufPtr: Y = buffer (0-5) -> $5A/$5B = its address in bank 0.
BufPtr:
TYA
LSR
LSR
CLC
ADC #$38
STA $5B
TYA
AND #$03
LSR
ROR
ROR
STA $5A
RTS

; CopyBlock: A = library block, Y = buffer (0-5). The library sits under
; the KERNAL ROM: bank it out (interrupts off) for the 63-byte copy.
CopyBlock:
LDX #$00
STX $59
ASL
ROL $59
ASL
ROL $59
ASL
ROL $59
ASL
ROL $59
ASL
ROL $59
ASL
ROL $59
CLC
ADC #$80
STA $58
LDA $59
ADC #$F2
STA $59
JSR BufPtr
SEI
LDA #$35
STA $01
LDY #62
CBLoop:
LDA ($58),Y
STA ($5A),Y
DEY
BPL CBLoop
LDA #$36
STA $01
CLI
RTS

; MirrorHR / MirrorMC: flip the sprite at ($5A) left-right, row by row:
; swap the outer bytes and reverse the bits (or the bit pairs) of all 3.
MirrorHR:
LDY #60
MHLoop:
LDA ($5A),Y
TAX
LDA $C200,X
STA $C03D
INY
INY
LDA ($5A),Y
TAX
LDA $C200,X
DEY
DEY
STA ($5A),Y
INY
INY
LDA $C03D
STA ($5A),Y
DEY
LDA ($5A),Y
TAX
LDA $C200,X
STA ($5A),Y
DEY
DEY
DEY
DEY
BPL MHLoop
RTS

MirrorMC:
LDY #60
MMLoop:
LDA ($5A),Y
TAX
LDA $C300,X
STA $C03D
INY
INY
LDA ($5A),Y
TAX
LDA $C300,X
DEY
DEY
STA ($5A),Y
INY
INY
LDA $C03D
STA ($5A),Y
DEY
LDA ($5A),Y
TAX
LDA $C300,X
STA ($5A),Y
DEY
DEY
DEY
DEY
BPL MMLoop
RTS

; ---------------------------------------------------------------
; DrawPose: she is busy with an action ($B116 gives the pose). Sitting
; swings its legs, the swing rocks on an arc, the slide runs down a path,
; work paces behind the counter, eating munches, cheering hops.
; ---------------------------------------------------------------
DrawPose:
LDA $C001
STA $C037
LDA $C031
STA $C038
LDA $D015
ORA #$07
STA $D015
LDA $C02F
CMP #$01
BNE DPNotSit
DPSitFrame:
LDA $C030            ; legs swing
LSR
LSR
LSR
AND #$01
CLC
ADC #$05
JMP DPSet
DPNotSit:
CMP #$02
BNE DPNotSwing
LDA $C030
AND #$1F
TAX
LDA $C001
CLC
ADC $B172,X
STA $C037
LDA $C031
CLC
ADC $B192,X
STA $C038
JMP DPSitFrame
DPNotSwing:
CMP #$03
BNE DPNotSlide
LDA $C030            ; 90..67 sit at the top, 66..35 slide, then cheer
CMP #67
BCS DPSitFrame
CMP #35
BCC DPSlideEnd
SEC
SBC #35
EOR #$1F
TAX
LDA $B1B2,X
STA $C037
LDA $B1D2,X
STA $C038
JMP DPSitFrame
DPSlideEnd:
LDA $B1D1
STA $C037
STA $C001               ; she ends the pose at the bottom
LDA #$9A
STA $C038
LDA #$09
JMP DPSet
DPNotSlide:
CMP #$04
BNE DPNotLie
LDA #$0A
JMP DPSet
DPNotLie:
CMP #$08
BNE DPNotShower
LDA $D015              ; behind the curtain: just bubbles
AND #$F8
STA $D015
JMP DPTick
DPNotShower:
CMP #$09
BNE DPNotWork
LDA $C025            ; pace behind the counter
AND #$01
BNE DPWorkDraw
LDA $C002
BNE DPWorkLeft
INC $C001
LDA $C001
SEC
SBC $C032
CMP #22
BCC DPWorkDraw
LDA #$01
STA $C002
JMP DPWorkDraw
DPWorkLeft:
DEC $C001
LDA $C001
CMP $C032
BNE DPWorkDraw
LDA #$00
STA $C002
DPWorkDraw:
LDA $C001
STA $C037
LDA $C025            ; walking in profile: stride (2 lines lower) /
AND #$08               ; legs together, as in DrawGirl
BNE DPWorkStep
INC $C038
INC $C038
LDA #$01
JMP DPSet
DPWorkStep:
LDA #$02
JMP DPSet

hourly. FIRE uses an object:

nodes.title: CODE BLOCK
code:
; ---------------------------------------------------------------
; ClockTick: every 150 frames (3 s) = 10 game minutes.
; Each hour the needs drop a little ($AD29) and the sky changes.
; ---------------------------------------------------------------
ClockTick:
LDA $C033         ; the clock stands still while she sleeps
BEQ CTRun
RTS
CTRun:
INC $C00D
LDA $C00D
CMP #$96
BCC CTDone
LDA #$00
STA $C00D
LDA #$01               ; a real-time hour can empty a need (faint);
STA $C02A             ; hours spent inside an action stop at 1
JSR AddTime
LDA #$00
STA $C02A
JMP RefreshClock
CTDone:
RTS

; AddTime: A = how many 10-minute steps pass.
AddTime:
STA $C02D
ATLoop:
LDA $C02D
BEQ ATDone
DEC $C02D
INC $C00C
LDA $C00C
CMP #6
BCC ATLoop
LDA #$00
STA $C00C
JSR NextHour
JMP ATLoop
ATDone:
RTS

NextHour:
INC $C00B
LDA $C00B
CMP #24
BCC NHDecay
LDA #$00
STA $C00B
INC $C00A
NHDecay:
LDA $C028
BEQ NHCool
DEC $C028
NHCool:
LDX #4
NHNeed:
LDA $AD29,X
EOR #$FF
CLC
ADC #$01
STX $C02E
LDY $C02A
BEQ NHSoft
JSR AddNeed
JMP NHNext
NHSoft:
JSR AddNeedSoft
NHNext:
LDX $C02E
DEX
BPL NHNeed
JSR RefreshBars
JSR SetSky
LDA $C00B             ; cafe closing time while she is there
CMP #18
BNE NHWarn
LDA $C000
CMP #$05
BNE NHWarn
LDA #$81
JMP PrintMsg
NHWarn:
LDX #$00               ; first need running low -> warning
NHWLoop:
LDA $C00E,X
CMP #8
BCC NHWShow
INX
CPX #5
BNE NHWLoop
RTS
NHWShow:
LDA $B106,X
JSR PrintMsg
JMP SndError

; AddNeed: X = need (0-4), A = signed change. Result clamped 0-48.
AddNeed:
CLC
ADC $C00E,X
BMI ANZero
CMP #49
BCC ANStore
LDA #48
JMP ANStore
ANZero:
LDA #$00
ANStore:
STA $C00E,X
RTS

; AddNeedSoft: as AddNeed, but never below 1. Actions, stings, sleep and
; magic can run a need low; only the hourly drop can empty it (faint).
AddNeedSoft:
JSR AddNeed
LDA $C00E,X
BNE ANSDone
LDA #$01
STA $C00E,X
ANSDone:
RTS

code:
; ---------------------------------------------------------------
; CheckSpot: which object (if any) is she standing at? When it changes,
; show its prompt (or the room's hint / the clue's hint).
; ---------------------------------------------------------------
CheckSpot:
LDA $C02F             ; busy: keep the action's message up
BEQ CSFree
RTS
CSFree:
LDA $C001
CLC
ADC #6
LSR
LSR
STA $C01F               ; her centre column
LDX $C000
LDA $AE4A,X
TAX
LDY #4
CSLoop:
LDA $ADC6,X
CMP #$FF
BEQ CSNone
LDA $C01F
CMP $ADC6,X
BCC CSNext
LDA $ADC7,X
CMP $C01F
BCC CSNext
LDA $ADC8,X
JMP CSFound
CSNext:
INX
INX
INX
DEY
BNE CSLoop
CSNone:
LDA #$FF
CSFound:
CMP $C01D
BEQ CSSame
STA $C01D
CMP #$FF
BEQ CSHint
TAX
LDA $AF69,X
TAX
LDA $AF3B,X
JMP PrintMsg

LDX $C042             ; a clue here? its hint, else the room's
BEQ CSRoom
LDA $B2A9,X
JMP PrintMsg
CSRoom:

LDA $B10B,X
JMP PrintMsg
CSSame:
RTS

; ---------------------------------------------------------------
; DoAction (FIRE): use the object she stands at. The action table gives
; need changes, the price, the time it takes and the messages; special
; actions (sleep, eat, groceries, work, talk) add their own rules.
; ---------------------------------------------------------------
DoAction:
LDA $C01D
CMP #$00
BNE DANotSleep
JMP DoSleep
DANotSleep:
TAX
LDA $AF69,X
STA $C021               ; T2 = offset of this action's row
TAX
LDA $AF24,X
CMP #$02
BNE DANotEat
LDA $C009
BNE DAEatOk
LDA #$67
JMP DAFail
DAEatOk:
DEC $C009
JMP DAPay
DANotEat:
CMP #$04
BNE DAPay
LDA $C00B
CMP #8
BCC DAClosed
CMP #18
BCS DAClosed
LDA $C00F
CMP #10
BCS DAPay
LDA #$69
JMP DAFail
DAClosed:
LDA #$68
JMP DAFail
DAPay:
LDX $C021
LDA $AEC8,X
BEQ DANeeds
JSR HaveMoney
BCS DAPayOk
LDA #$66
JMP DAFail
DAPayOk:
LDX $C021
LDA $AEC8,X
JSR SubMoney
DANeeds:
LDA #$00
STA $C02E
LDA $C021
PHA
DANLoop:
LDX $C021               ; need T4's column, then step to the next
LDA $AE55,X
LDX $C02E
JSR AddNeedSoft
LDA $C021
CLC
ADC #$17
STA $C021
INC $C02E
LDA $C02E
CMP #5
BNE DANLoop
PLA
STA $C021
LDX $C01D              ; act it out
JSR StartPose
LDX $C021
LDA $AF24,X
CMP #$05
BNE DANotTalk
JMP DoTalk
DANotTalk:
CMP #$03
BNE DANotGroc
LDA $C009
CLC
ADC #3
CMP #10
BCC DAGrocOk
LDA #9
DAGrocOk:
STA $C009
JMP DATime
DANotGroc:
CMP #$04
BNE DATime
JSR DoWork
DATime:
LDX $C021
LDA $AEDF,X
JSR AddTime
JSR SndUse
LDX $C021
LDA $C003
BNE DAHexMsg
LDA $AEF6,X
JMP DAMsg
DAHexMsg:
LDA $AF0D,X
DAMsg:
JSR PrintMsg
JSR RefreshHud
LDA $C013            ; the fifth job level is the dream come true
CMP #5
BCC DADone
JMP WinGame
DADone:
RTS
DAFail:
JSR PrintMsg
JMP SndError

; DoTalk: chat with the person here. Gran hands over the baby photo the
; first time; Miss Page has the old newspaper once you hold five clues.
; Otherwise they say their next line (four each, in turn).
DoTalk:
LDX $C021
LDA $AF52,X
STA $C03E               ; who
LDA #60
STA $C041             ; they bob while they talk
LDX $C021
LDA $AEDF,X
JSR AddTime
JSR RefreshHud
LDA $C03E
CMP #$01
BNE DTNotGran
LDA $C046
AND #$01
BNE DTLine
LDX #$00
JMP GiveClue
DTNotGran:
CMP #$03
BNE DTLine
LDA $C046
AND #$20
BNE DTLine
LDA $C047
CMP #5
BCC DTLine
LDX #$05
JMP GiveClue
DTLine:
JSR SndUse
LDX $C03E
LDA $C048,X           ; this line...
CLC
ADC $B26C,X
PHA
LDA $C048,X           ; ...and the next one next time
CLC
ADC #$01
AND #$03
STA $C048,X
PLA
JMP PrintMsg

; DoWork: pay the wage (+tips for Sunny), job XP (Hex works double hard),
; promotion every 6 XP. No XP when scruffy (WASH low).
DoWork:
LDX $C013
LDA $ADC0,X
LDX $C003
BNE DWPay
CLC
ADC #4                 ; Sunny's tips
DWPay:
JSR AddMoney
LDA $C010
CMP #12
BCS DWXp
PLA                    ; skip the normal result message
PLA
LDX $C021
LDA $AEDF,X
JSR AddTime
JSR RefreshHud
LDA #$6A
JSR PrintMsg
JMP SndError
DWXp:
INC $C014
LDA $C003
BEQ DWCheck
INC $C014
DWCheck:
LDA $C014
CMP #6
BCC DWDone
LDA #$00
STA $C014
INC $C013
PLA                    ; promotion replaces the normal message
PLA
LDX $C021
LDA $AEDF,X
JSR AddTime
JSR RefreshHud
JSR SndPromote
LDX $C013
LDA $B1F4,X
JSR PrintMsg
LDA $C013
CMP #5
BCC DWDone
LDA #150
JSR Pause
JMP WinGame
DWDone:
RTS

; DoSleep: in bed at night (20:00-5:59) or when very tired: sleep till
; 7:00 next morning, REST full. Otherwise just a nap. Either way she lies
; in bed (the LIE pose) with a Zzz; the clock stands still while she sleeps.
DoSleep:
LDA $C00B
CMP #20
BCS DSSleep
CMP #6
BCC DSSleep
LDA $C00F
CMP #16
BCC DSSleep
LDA #12
LDX #1
JSR AddNeedSoft
LDA #6
JSR AddTime
JSR SndUse
LDA #$65
JSR PrintMsg
JSR RefreshHud
LDX #$00
JMP StartPose
DSSleep:
JSR SndSleep
LDA #$00
STA $C015
STA $C018
LDA $D015              ; no coin or bee while she sleeps
AND #$0F
STA $D015
LDX #$00
JSR StartPose
LDA #$C8
STA $C030
LDA #$01
STA $C033
LDA #$06               ; night sky
STA $C026
LDA #$7E
JMP PrintMsg

; WakeUp: the night is over (the LIE pose ended).
WakeUp:
LDA #$00
STA $C033
LDA $C00B
CMP #7
BCC WUSameDay
INC $C00A
WUSameDay:
LDA #7
STA $C00B
LDA #$00
STA $C00C
STA $C00D
LDA #48
STA $C00F
LDA #$F6
LDX #0
JSR AddNeedSoft
LDA #$F8
LDX #2
JSR AddNeedSoft
JSR SetSky
JSR RefreshHud
LDX $C003
LDA #$24
CPX #$00
BEQ WUMsg
LDA #$25
WUMsg:
JMP PrintMsg

; Pause: A = frames to wait (music keeps playing).
Pause:
STA $C02D
PLoop:
JSR FrameTick
DEC $C02D
BNE PLoop
RTS

; CheckFaint: a need at zero -> she faints, wakes in bed 4 hours later.
CheckFaint:
LDX #4
CFLoop:
LDA $C00E,X
BEQ CFFaint
DEX
BPL CFLoop
RTS
CFFaint:
JSR SndOuch
LDA #$7D
JSR PrintMsg
LDA #$00
STA $D015
STA $C02F
STA $C033
STA $C03A
LDA #120
JSR Pause
LDA #24                ; 4 hours pass while she recovers...
JSR AddTime
LDX #4                 ; ...then she wakes with every need at 16+
CFFix:
LDA $C00E,X
CMP #16
BCS CFOk
LDA #16
STA $C00E,X
CFOk:
DEX
BPL CFFix
LDA #10
JSR HaveMoney
BCC CFBroke
LDA #10
JSR SubMoney
JMP CFHome
CFBroke:
LDA #$00
STA $C008
CFHome:
LDA #$7D
JSR PrintMsg
LDA #$07
STA $D015
LDA #$02         ; she wakes up in the bedroom
STA $C000
LDA #40
STA $C001
JSR RefreshHud
LDA #$FF
STA $C01D              ; keep the faint message up
LDX #$FF
TXS
JMP EnterRoomKeep

; ---------------------------------------------------------------
; PrintPage: X = page (0 how to play, 1 dream come true, 2 the truth).
; One small loop instead of a PRINT node per line: each line of the page
; table gives row, column, colour and length; its text follows on in
; the page's TEXT_DATA asset. A row of $FF ends the page.
; ---------------------------------------------------------------
PrintPage:
LDA $B369,X
STA $58
LDA $B36C,X
STA $59
LDA $B36F,X
STA $5C
LDA $B372,X
STA $5D
PPLine:
LDY #$00
LDA ($5C),Y            ; row
CMP #$FF
BEQ PPDone
TAX
INY
LDA $B2B8,X
CLC
ADC ($5C),Y            ; + column
STA $5A
STA $5E
LDA $B2D1,X
ADC #$00
STA $5B
CLC
ADC #$D8
STA $5F                ; $5E = colour RAM
LDA $5B
CLC
ADC #$04
STA $5B                ; $5A = screen
INY
LDA ($5C),Y
STA $C03D               ; colour
INY
LDA ($5C),Y
STA $C03E               ; length
LDY #$00
PPChar:
CPY $C03E
BEQ PPNext
LDA ($58),Y
STA ($5A),Y
LDA $C03D
STA ($5E),Y
INY
BNE PPChar
PPNext:
LDA $58
CLC
ADC $C03E
STA $58
BCC PPText
INC $59
PPText:
LDA $5C
CLC
ADC #4
STA $5C
BCC PPLine
INC $5D
JMP PPLine
PPDone:
RTS
